multimedia.options.title: MultiMedia – Settings
multimedia.options.titles.tooltip: Shows the song that is currently playing above the jukebox.
multimedia.options.title_background.tool: Dark box behind the title so it is easier to read.
multimedia.options.title_distance.toolti: How far away the title is visible.
multimedia.options.notes.tooltip:
Note particles in time with the music.
Few: only on clear beats. Many: more notes per beat.
multimedia.options.now_playing.tooltip: Popup above the hotbar when a new song starts.
multimedia.options.chat.tooltip: Hints like download progress in chat. Errors and command replies are always shown.
multimedia.options.enabled.tooltip: Off: you no longer hear the streams (until restart or until you turn it back on).
multimedia.options.reverb.tooltip: Reverb depending on the room: big stone halls echo long, wool rooms barely.
multimedia.options.walls.tooltip: How much walls between you and the jukebox muffle the music.
multimedia.options.block.tooltip:
0 = lets everything through, 10 = muffles like stone.
All the way left (default) removes your own setting.
multimedia.options.blocks_hint: Custom blocks: look at a block + /disc block <0-10>
multimedia.options.blocks_hint.tooltip: Look at a block and type /disc block <0-10>, then it shows up here.
multimedia.options.screens.tooltip: Show videos on screens (sign "bildschirm"). Off saves performance.
multimedia.options.screen_brightness.too: How bright the video on screens is. With shaders it often looks overexposed – try about 60–75 %.
multimedia.options.lean_view.tooltip: Right-click a jukebox: the camera leans over it, where you pick discs, edit the sign and control playback. Sneak + right-click works as usual.
